nota: Relidos no release (PDF) e na página "Atlantic" da Five Deeps. "The first person to reach the deepest point of the Atlantic", nunca "the first human at the bottom" (N03).
citacoes: the first human to dive on a solo mission to the deepest point in the Atlantic
in his private submersible, the Limiting Factor
after an approximate two-and-a-half hour descent

pedidos.pedido: F39 (S04, S05): sozinho; ~2 h 30 min de descida; o primeiro a chegar ao ponto mais fundo do Atlântico. Tela ≈ 2 H 30 MIN.
